name: Fish
desc: A specimen pulled out of a rupture and held to the shape it assumed on the way through. Right-click to stow it with others of its kind; hold control to stow every one aboard.

name: Catch Bundle
desc: Specimens of one species, stowed together. Right-click to unpack them; hold control to sweep every fish aboard into one pile.

name: Catch Pile
desc: Every specimen aboard on one line, so the hold can be read. Worth exactly what it was worth in crates. Right-click to unpack loose singles and crate repeated species.
